title: Choosing 'name Vell's blood to the Regent' — revealing a companion's secret exiled-royal lineage that she had explicitly asked to keep private ('I'd rather you heard it from me than the throne') — produced gold and a Crown reputation change but no regard shift and no reaction line from Vell at all, unlike almost every other consequential choice in the game, which reliably fires an approves/disapproves flag plus a follow-up line.
where: The Regent's Chambers / 'name Vell's blood to the Regent'
